en.headline: Gelato market returns to PMQ for a second weekend
en.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest opens again at PMQ in Central from Friday to Sunday, with free entry and stalls from 20 makers.
body: A gelato market organised by Circus Media is back at PMQ in Central for a second weekend, running from Friday to Sunday, 9 to 11 October.

PMQ lists the event in the ground-floor courtyard and marketplace, open from noon to 10pm each day. Admission is free. The organiser describes it as an Italian-style gelato market bringing together 20 brands from Hong Kong, Macau, Portugal and Italy.
The same listing shows an earlier run from 1 to 4 October. Scoops are sold at the stalls. PMQ has not published a separate ticket or booking requirement for entry.
PMQ occupies the former Hollywood Road Police Married Quarters on Hollywood Road. The gelato market sits on the ground floor, separate from the studio shops upstairs.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集今起再登陸中環元創方
zh.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest 周五至周日在元創方地下舉行，入場免費，約20個品牌設檔。
body: 由 Circus Media 主辦的雪糕市集今個周末再在中環元創方舉行，日期為10月9日至11日，即周五至周日。
元創方活動資料寫明，市集設於地下中庭及市集空間，每日中午12時至晚上10時開放，入場免費。主辦單位形容這是意式雪糕市集，匯集來自香港、澳門、葡萄牙及意大利約20個品牌。
同一活動早前已於10月1日至4日辦過一輪。雪糕在檔位售賣。元創方的活動頁沒有另列入場門票或預約安排。
元創方位於荷李活道前荷李活道已婚警察宿舍。這次雪糕市集在地面進行，與樓上工作室舖位分開。
